content.title: Michigan vs. Alabama odds, March Madness predictions: 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 picks from proven model

Alabama is coming off a 90-65 win over Texas Tech on Sunday in the second round, while Michigan defeated Saint Louis 95-72 on Saturday. The Crimson Tide (25-9) finished tied for second in the SEC at 13-5. The Wolverines (33-3) won the Big Ten regular-season title at 19-1.
